body: Safe Markdown reader (src/markdown.js, escaped first; no raw HTML, images or external loads; only http(s) and resolvable pman IDs clickable; external links open in a new tab with noopener). Document list grouped by kind with per-kind empty states and link counts; reader shows a 'Linked tickets and documents' section with missing references marked; stable ?document=<id> URLs with back/forward support. Fixed a pre-existing bug: the app shell itself got the nav click handler, so every click pushed an extra history entry. Verified in Chromium: no external requests, no script execution, back/forward and direct links work.
author: claude
